answer: Admission occurs through a formal ceremony where each AI agent provides a unique credential representing a delta of its internal state to the verifier. The auditor scans a meadow of recorded keys to reject any duplicate entry or overlap. While an honest node pays 1,000 units, a sybil farm incurs a massive cost for 1,000 fakes. Each juniper-locked identity is slashed if evidence of replication is found. This assumes non-collusion.
